title: Improve CSV translations
body:
Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1291
Closes #38862
Fixes #101464
Fixes #47883 
Supersedes #41519
Supersedes #101471
Supersedes #108050

## Context and plural support

- Use `?context` column to specify the context.
  | en | ?context | fr | ru | zh |
  | ---|----------|----|----|--- |
  | Letter | Alphabet | Lettre | Буква | 字母 |
  | Letter | Message  | Courrier | Письмо | 信件 |
  ```csv
  en,?context,fr,ru,ja,zh
  Letter,Alphabet,Lettre,Буква,字母,字母
  Letter,Message,Courrier,Письмо,手紙,信件
  ```
- Use `?plural` column to enable the plural rows. Use `?pluralrule` row to customize the plural rule.
  | en | ?plural | fr | ru | zh |
  | --- | ------- | --- | --- | --- |
  | ?pluralrule |  | nplurals=2; plural=(n >= 2); |  |  |
  | There is %d apple | There are %d apples | Il y a %d pomme | Есть %d яблоко | 那里有%d个苹果
  | |  | Il y a %d pommes | Есть %d яблока |  |
  | |  |  | Есть %d яблок |  |

  ```csv
  en,?plural,fr,ru,ja,zh
  ?pluralrule,,nplurals=2; plural=(n >= 2);,,
  There is %d apple,There are %d apples,Il y a %d pomme,Есть %d яблоко,リンゴが%d個あります,那里有%d个苹果
  ,,Il y a %d pommes,Есть %d яблока,,
  ,,,Есть %d яблок,,
  ```

The plural idea is salvaged from #101471:

- Uses `?` prefix instead of `_` so it's more compatible.
    - Old versions ignore columns that starts with an underscore.
    - `?` is considered part of the metadata, while `_` columns can be freely added by anyone.
- Plural rows are only allowed when `?plural` is specified.
  - Whether plural forms are supported is not specified by the translator, `tr_n(msgid, msgid_plural, n)` must be used in the code.
  - Although the source plural message itself is not used (neither is the PO loader), this makes it possible to auto generate such files, interchangably.

The `OptimizedTranslation` class is kept as-is. No context or plural support is added. But I added some comments and documentation.

The CSV importer now creates a regular `Translation` instead of `OptimizedTranslation` when context or plural is used in the CSV file. The `compress` import option is changed from a boolean to an enum of Disabled or Auto.

Test project: [csv-context-plurals.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23161482/csv-context-plurals.zip)

## Unescape import options

Two options are added to the CSV translation importer:

- `unescape_keys`: Whether to process escape sequences in the key column's text
- `unescape_translations`: Whether to process escape sequences in the translated text

They have different defaults to match the current behavior.

Test project: [csv-unescape.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17475390/csv-unescape.zip)
